why: Decision 0006: no Nordic element reaches the player through what we add; the gear of Skyrim's own peoples and orders (Nords, draugr, Stormcloaks, Falmer, Forsworn, Skaal stalhrim, the Dawnguard, the Blades, Penitus Oculatus, the hold guards) has no road into Black Marsh in 4E 201. Joined on our material: a Black Marsh piece whose record carries one of these keywords (an HTBM Kothringi helm, a KotM tribal robe) is filed by item_material under its true material and is not blocked.
